summary: All finite non-Detransitive occurrences retain harvesting meaning, with crop objects expressed or omitted. b- marks tools, hands or remuneration; none supplies a distinct verb-plus-preposition meaning.

Infinitiv ḥṣodo names an event, season, purpose or completed task. It is moved out of the inherited Detransitive filing; the existing wording is preserved. In contrast kməḥṣodi has the crop as participant, and ḥsido/ḥṣide describes its resulting state.
Infectum-wa is widely supported in JTM and independent MAC interviews, including 3sg, 1pl, 2pl and patient-suffixed forms. Its absence is a missing box, not an unattested root.
Part act. ḥaṣodo/ḥaṣode is an occupational noun. The existing 6/7–8 example remains correctly placed because 6/8 includes ḥaṣode, even though 6/7 alone has the event noun ḥṣodo.
Plain s in g̥̊ḥosad̥, ḥsido and ḥusdíwayna is retained as printed; farming contexts support ḥṣd, without changing the source spelling or assigning the envy root.
The 94/87 translation has substantial extra detail absent from this verse. It is withheld; 94/86 also lacks a translation for the final tool sentence, so that sentence is not published as an example.
Round 2 only. Jan English is a project machine translation; semantic decisions are based on the Turoyo. Round-1 proposals remain prior material and are not re-proposed here.
Detransitive məḥṣadwo and məḥṣodi contrast with active ḥəṣdiwo; explicit aṣ ṣʕore in the answer (1.50/2302) supports a crop participant and omitted worker.
Jan confirms habitual farm labor and hand/sickle harvesting established in round 1. Active Infectum-wa and Preterit are no longer missing boxes.
ḥaṣədto contrasts with occupational Ḥaṣode in the mechanization passage (1.50/2270), but machine versus action-noun meaning is unresolved. No new idiom is established.

summary: fadono measures the area harvested rather than naming crop material (MAC Ishaq Material culture/103); this is an extent-object extension. Nominal u+ḥṣodo kule can refer to the yield (MAC NE Interview 2/86), without requiring a separate verbal sense.
Jan corroborates round-1 ordinary Infinitiv filing: purpose lu ḥṣodo, time bu ḥṣodo/bəṯər mu ḥṣodo, and crop genitives daḥ ḥəmṣe. No new Detransitive nominal sense.
